name: Tamu Grill and Catering
neighborhoodOrCity: Cedar-Riverside area, Minneapolis (former Viking Bar building, Riverside Ave.)
whatItIs: Family-run Kenyan restaurant by Chef George "Jojo" Ndege, opened under this name July 9, 2022 (formerly Kilimanjaro Grill); tilapia, beef and coconut-curry beans, samosas, chapati, ugali; catering and Taste of Minnesota stand.
evidence: Own site, copyright 2026, lists restaurant hours Thursday to Sunday 2:00 to 8:00 p.m. and takeout ordering.

name: Karibu Grocery and Deli
neighborhoodOrCity: 719 Payne Ave., East Side, St. Paul
whatItIs: East African grocery and deli opened October 2018 by three Ali siblings from a Kenyan family; halal meats, groceries, East African dishes, Kenyan coffee, burgers and fries.
evidence: Own site lists address and daily opening hours (Monday to Saturday from noon or 1 p.m. to 8 p.m.; Sunday 1 to 4:30 p.m.); the hours are not dated.

name: Mshale
whatItIs: African immigrant newspaper founded in the mid-1990s by Kenyan-born publisher Tom Gitaa; monthly print, weekly newsletter, daily website.
evidence: Meet Minneapolis media directory updated Oct. 15, 2026 lists Mshale with Tom Gitaa as publisher; Metro State's spring 2025 alumni notes list him as founder, editor-in-chief and publisher. Mshale's own site blocked reading.

name: African Rhythms (KFAI 90.3 FM)
whatItIs: Weekly Sunday noon to 2 p.m. African music show co-hosted by George "Jojo" Ndege and Salif Keita.
evidence: Spinitron playlist page shows a show aired Oct. 25, 2026.

name: Pamoja Kenya
whatItIs: Member-funded mutual-benefit organization classed by the IRS with local benevolent life insurance associations; $1,140,422 revenue in 2025, nearly all from members.
evidence: IRS Form 990 data for fiscal year ending December 2025 shown on ProPublica.

name: Mwanyagetinge (Mwanyagetinge Association of Kenyans in Minnesota)
whatItIs: Largest organized group of Kenyans in Minnesota by CCX Media's and Kenyans.co.ke's accounts; founded mid-1980s; training, job placement, advocacy, annual picnic.
evidence: Latest opened records are a 2022 IRS filing and a February 2023 election report; ProPublica notes it is not on the IRS's most recent exempt-organization list. No 2025 or 2026 activity found in an opened page.

name: Kenyan Community Seventh-day Adventist Church
whatItIs: Adventist church named for its Kenyan co-founders in 1998, open to people of all backgrounds.
evidence: Church calendar lists youth small-group meetings in October 2026.

name: Minnesota Swahili Christian Congregation
neighborhoodOrCity: Holy Trinity Lutheran Church, 2730 E. 31st St., Minneapolis
whatItIs: Lutheran worship in Swahili Sundays at noon for Swahili speakers and East Africans; pastor from Tanzania.
evidence: Host church's current partners page describes weekly Sunday 12:00 p.m. services and gives the pastor's contact.

name: Kenyan Christian Outreach Church
whatItIs: Church registered as tax-exempt in January 2007.
evidence: Only an IRS registration record was found; no current services or website.

name: Minnesota Kenyan International Development Association (MKIDA)
whatItIs: Kenya-focused development nonprofit, tax-exempt since November 2004.
evidence: IRS registration record only; no dated 2025 or 2026 activity found.

name: Kenya Rochester Community
whatItIs: Kenyan community group, tax-exempt since August 2025.
evidence: IRS exemption issued August 2025, per ProPublica.

name: Rochester Kenyan Community Association (RKCA)
whatItIs: Kenyan community association, tax-exempt since April 2026.
evidence: IRS exemption issued April 2026, per ProPublica.

name: Southwest Minnesota Kenyan Community Welfare Association
whatItIs: Kenyan community welfare group classed as mutual/membership benefit, tax-exempt since April 2026.
evidence: IRS exemption issued April 2026, per ProPublica.

name: Kenya Society for Academic Advancement
whatItIs: Education nonprofit registered as tax-exempt in February 2009.
evidence: IRS registration record only; no current activity found.
